title: A `static` constructor compiles, and `new` calls it.
text: `public static function constructor(int $n) { … }` passes `nvs check`, and `new A(3)` runs its body with no object. A static method has no `$this`, so such a constructor cannot assign a property, and a class whose properties all have defaults hides that. It closes when `static` on a `constructor` is a diagnostic, with a conformance case.
